description: This Java class models the <server> XML element used in OFBiz service configuration, encapsulating server-related configuration data including jndi names, server type, and connection details.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Encapsulates server configuration settings parsed from a <server> XML element, with attributes such as jndi names, server type, credentials, and listening mode.

methods.name: Server
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Server object by parsing attributes from an XML Element, and throws ServiceConfigException if required attributes are missing or empty.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the server configuration.

methods.name: getJndiName
methods.description: Returns the JNDI name of the server.

methods.name: getListen
methods.description: Indicates whether the server is set to listen mode (true/false).

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password used for server connection.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username for server authentication.
